highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3 previews Linux ARM64 reliability fixes and refreshed bundled native dependencies.
highlights_body: It also fixes an ahead-of-time compilation crash in applications that disable reflection.

bullets.detail: The cross-compile sysroot now includes the required fontconfig runtime library, preventing a native crash on Linux ARM64.

bullets.lead: AOT applications no longer crash without reflection
bullets.detail: Applications compiled with IlcDisableReflection enabled can load SkiaSharp safely.
The preview updates libpng, libwebp, brotli, and the Skia submodule.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Windows and Linux native binary hardening

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Linux ARM64, AOT, and dependency servicing updates.
